ABOUT VOODOO

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way

TEAM

Blitz is a gaming platform launched by Voodoo in 2021, allowing players to compete on mobile games for real cash prizes (head-up, tournaments, leagues, etc.). It is leveraging Voodoo’s unique game portfolio to engage users in a fun and rewarding way.

ROLE

- Create mobile video ads that engage millions of people (both paid and organic content)

- Become a creative expert in mobile gaming/app: benchmark what our competitors are doing, experiment with new ideas

- Develop a deep understanding of how your creations perform and why

- Work within a small creative squad with amazing people from diverse backgrounds and nationalities

- Contribute to transversal initiatives (e.g., testing new tools)

PROFILE

- At least 3+ year of experience in a similar role

- Hands-on experience with AI creative tools (Scenario, Seedance, Kling, Veo, Runway, etc.)

- Fully proficient with video editing and content creation

- Expert in After Effects - Nice to have: 3D softwares and/or Unity

- Creative and have a hacker mindset

- Understand how your creations drive marketing performance

- Fluent in English, both oral and written

BENEFITS

- Competitive salary

- Premium healthcare (SideCare) for you and your family 100% borne by Voodoo

- Swile Lunch voucher

- Gymlib (100% borne by Voodoo)

- Wellness activities in our Paris office

- Flexible vacation policy

- Remote days

- Child daycare facilities (Les Petits Chaperons rouges)
